I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka wrote that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note later that day says Southgate cleared the backlog.

Her first message says "depots", plural, but Southgate is the only site the channel names.
